name: Pratapgad Battle Site
description: The site of the legendary Battle of Pratapgad (1659), where Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj defeated Afzal Khan. The battlefield lies at the base of Pratapgad Fort and is marked by a memorial and the Afzal Khan tomb.
historicalSignificance: Turning point in Maratha history, established Shivaji Maharaj as a formidable leader.

landmarks.name: Afzal Khan Tomb
landmarks.description: Tomb of the Bijapur general Afzal Khan.

landmarks.name: Battle Memorial
landmarks.description: Plaque and statues commemorating the battle.

reviews: Standing here brings history to life!
Combine with a visit to Pratapgad Fort.
